tasker_principles.title: Tasker Principles
tasker_principles.subtitle: Principles for people who do the work on BitTasker.
tasker_principles.heading: Tasker Principles
tasker_principles.description: These principles are for workers. They cover how to take work, do it, and get paid on a non-custodial marketplace.

1.title: 1. Clear scope
1.text: Agree the scope before you start. Know what was posted, what you bid, and what done looks like.

2.title: 2. Deliver what you bid
2.text: Do the work you offered, on the terms you agreed.

3.title: 3. Communicate
3.text: Keep the person who posted the task informed while the work is underway.

4.title: 4. Non-custodial escrow release on completion
4.text: Payment sits in non-custodial escrow and is released when the work is complete. BitTasker does not hold the funds.

5.title: 5. Respectful conduct
5.text: Treat the other person with respect.
